title: Fixed-scalar coefficient pullback respects composition
statement: Fix a finite purity setting P [def-pur-conventions], positive levels 1 <= m <= P.level, arbitrary schemes X,Y,Z and maps f:X -> Y, g:Y -> Z. Use Q_T=finiteTensorReduction [def-pur-finite-tensor-reduction-data], c_f(K)=finiteTensorPullbackComparison [def-pur-finite-tensor-fixed-comparisons], and alpha_A(f,g): (f followed by g)_A^* -> f_A^* g_A^* given by compositionFixedPullbackComp [def-pur-composition-comparisons], with alpha_B the same compositor at the reduced setting. For every derived fixed-scalar sheaf K on Z, Q_X(alpha_A(f,g)_K);c_f(g_A^*K);f_B^*(c_g(K)) = c_(f followed by g)(K);alpha_B(f,g)_(Q_Z K). Semicolons are composition in application order. No field-structure morphisms, flatness of the quotient ring, smoothness, or finite-Tor hypothesis on K is imposed.

proof.text: Apply the composition and coefficient equations of cochainPullbackTensorCoherence. The compositor is the inverse-image composition map followed by scalar association. On every pure section, both composites send a section tensor b to its iterated inverse image tensor b. This gives an equality of cochain maps.

proof.text: The scalar unit sends x to x tensor 1, so the coefficient arrows are precisely the recorded scalar-adjunction mates. The pullback compositor is the adjunction conjugate of the restriction compositor. Naturality and the fact that mates commute with composition identify it with compositionFixedPullbackComp; the fixed coordinate maps are exactly those defining finiteTensorPullbackComparison.

proof.text: Descend the cochain equality through the localization equivalence and transport it through the scalar presentations and pullback model isomorphisms. Naturality and the adjunction triangle identities cancel the realization units and counits. Faithfulness of realization gives the fixed-scalar equality. Naturality along representative isomorphisms gives the result for all derived inputs. The same proof includes identity maps, empty schemes and equal coefficient levels.

theorem finiteTensorPullbackCompositionReduction (P : PurityFiniteSetting.{u})
    (m : ℕ) (hm : 1 ≤ m) (hmn : m ≤ P.level)
    {X Y Z : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y) (g : Y ⟶ Z) :
    ∀ K,
      (P.finiteTensorReduction m hm hmn X).map
          ((compositionFixedPullbackComp P.Ring f g).hom.app K) ≫
        (P.finiteTensorPullbackComparison m hm hmn f ((P.smoothPurityPullback g).obj K)).hom ≫
        ((P.finiteReductionSetting m hm).smoothPurityPullback f).map
          (P.finiteTensorPullbackComparison m hm hmn g K).hom =
      (P.finiteTensorPullbackComparison m hm hmn (f ≫ g) K).hom ≫
        (compositionFixedPullbackComp (P.finiteReductionSetting m hm).Ring f g).hom.app
          ((P.finiteTensorReduction m hm hmn Z).obj K)
